MastraCode: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on MastraCode

No replay has run on MastraCode. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about MastraCode.

What the MastraCode setup page says about coverage

MastraCode decides which tools go through MCP. KYA gates the ones that do. A tool MastraCode executes outside MCP is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the MastraCode recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
